explanatorySections.title: How to use this checklist tool
body: Answer a few questions about your stage, household, and employment. Generate a personalized task list for preparation, final prep, travel, and a short arrival-essentials handoff.
After you arrive, continue with the Arrival Planner (first week/month) and First 90 Days Planner (weeks 2–12). Use the Moving Checklist guide when you want the full educational overview.
